spec_match.rationale: Measures outputs[0][0].length inside a real AudioWorkletProcessor.process() call per hint — the frame count the render quantum actually controls — alongside the renderQuantumSize attribute.

interactive.rationale: Hint segmented buttons plus a run button drive a real worklet probe; results grid, frame-block visualisation, and timestamped log update per run.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The index card's promise matches the page's verified behaviour.

edge_cases.rationale: No-AudioWorklet and no-renderQuantumSize branches each have honest support-note text; the worklet promise has a 3 s timeout with an error log; the unsupported browser still measures the real (fixed 128) frame count rather than faking the hint.

references.rationale: Links the ChromeStatus entry and the renderSizeHint spec section.

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite ran in the verification browser at 5 pass / 4 fail / 0 blocked — the 4 fails are the shipped-attribute assertions, the honest 'not yet shipped' answer on Chromium 141 (anticipated Chrome 153), exactly as their descriptions state.

runtime_evidence.rationale: CDP page-driver run (headless Chromium 141 with autoplay permitted): with hint 512 the worklet measured the real 128 frames per process() call, 345 calls/s, renderQuantumSize '(not available)' — exactly the honest pre-ship behaviour the support note describes; console/network clean; screenshot v153-rq-worklet.png read.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts rq-worklet-probe-ran with framesPerCall, requested hint, and the renderQuantumSize readout.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons that override background also override color; small-text emerald readouts darkened via color-mix to meet AA.

accessibility.rationale: Support note is role=status; results are text values with mono sub-labels; the hint buttons are real buttons with visible active state plus text labels.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/webaudio-configurable-render-quantum --no-server: desktop OK clean, mobile OK (sub-44px flags are inline links, primary buttons/sliders remain usable); both screenshots read and judged clean.

openQuestions.title: Re-verify on a build where the Chrome 153 flip has landed
openQuestions.detail: The verification browser (Chromium 141, no origin trial) does not expose renderQuantumSize, so every hint is honestly reported as ignored. Once a Chrome 153 stable (or a build launched with --enable-blink-features=WebAudioConfigurableRenderQuantum) is available, re-run the page and confirm the quantum readouts flip to real values and the four not-yet conformance assertions pass.
